title: FUMI Tangy Strawberry Nicotine Pouches
description: FUMi Tangy Strawberry Nicotine Pouches deliver a classic fruit profile with a twist—sweet, smooth Strawberry lifted by a subtle tang for a flavour that’s both familiar and distinctive. It’s an easy-going pouch that suits everyday use. These slim, all-white pouches fit discreetly under the lip and provide a gradual release of nicotine and flavour for up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, they’re a clean and convenient option for any part of your day. Choose between 4mg (Regular) and 8mg (Strong) strengths. Each can includes 20 soft, plant-fibre pouches made in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Regular - 4mg this is best for new users. Extra Strong - 11mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
